notes: Ask for a resolution and Crisp now says what you will actually get — "Upscale 4× → 1280×720 — 4K needs a larger source" instead of a bare "Upscale 4×". "make it 720p" and "make it 1920x1080" work at all now, and "upscale to 8k" no longer answers with 1440p. Naming your clip a montage, recap or highlight reel no longer stops the other edits working, and "loop the highlight reel 3 times" repeats the clip instead of starting a 3× upscale.
